messages.description: Writes the values of selected states as history into an InfluxDB 1.x. States are selected individually in the properties dialog on the states page. A local database can be created via the initial setup; an existing installation on this or another server can be attached instead.
messages.title: InfluxDB
messages.no_states: No state selected yet. Selection happens on the states page via the pencil button next to the value.
messages.setup_connected: The database is connected. Initial setup is no longer offered so that existing data cannot be overwritten.
messages.setup_remote: A remote server is configured. Please provide an InfluxDB 1.x there and store the credentials in the instance settings.
messages.setup_installed: An InfluxDB is already installed on this server. Initial setup therefore stays hidden; please check the credentials.
messages.setup_privileged: This adapter runs with elevated privileges and can execute the bundled installation script itself.
messages.setup_no_rights: homeESS runs without elevated privileges and cannot install InfluxDB itself. To install InfluxDB, please enter the following in a root console:
messages.setup_command_hint: The script ships with the adapter and asks for the password without echoing it — it must match the password in the instance settings. Afterwards click "Check connection" below.
